<?php
function hook_coalesce_fallback32(): int { echo "R|"; return 13; }
class HookCoalesceScalar32 {
    public mixed $value = null {
        get { echo "G|"; return $this->value === false ? 7 : ($this->value === 7 ? false : $this->value); }
    }
    public function inspect(): void {
        $kept = $this->value ?? hook_coalesce_fallback32();
        echo $kept === false ? "TF|" : ($kept === 0 ? "T0|" : ($kept === 7 ? "T7|" : ($kept === 13 ? "T13|" : "TX|")));
    }
}
$box = new HookCoalesceScalar32;
foreach ([null, 0, false, 7] as $value) {
    $box->value = $value;
    $kept = $box->value ?? hook_coalesce_fallback32();
    echo $kept === false ? "F|" : ($kept === 0 ? "0|" : ($kept === 7 ? "7|" : ($kept === 13 ? "13|" : "X|")));
    $box->inspect();
}

<?php
class HookCoalesceLeaf32 {
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}
function hook_coalesce_leaf32(): object {
    global $weak;
    echo "G|";
    $leaf = new HookCoalesceLeaf32;
    $weak = WeakReference::create($leaf);
    return $leaf;
}
function hook_coalesce_fallback_leaf32(): object { echo "R|"; return new HookCoalesceLeaf32; }
class HookCoalesceBox32 {
    public object $value { get => hook_coalesce_leaf32(); }
    public function __destruct() { echo "B|"; }
}
$weak = null;
$box = new HookCoalesceBox32;
$kept = $box->value ?? hook_coalesce_fallback_leaf32();
echo $weak->get() === $kept ? "HELD|" : "X|";
unset($box);
echo $weak->get() === $kept ? "LIVE|" : "X|";
unset($kept);
echo $weak->get() === null ? "N|" : "X|";
